prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a consistent 2x2-grid high-fashion streetwear editorial of the same adult woman aged 22–26 in an urban industrial alleyway. She has a platinum-blonde straight bob with blunt bangs, steel-gray eyes, natural visible skin texture, a neon-orange oversized ripstop bomber jacket layered over a fitted black mesh top, charcoal tactical cargo pants, clean worn white platform sneakers, layered silver chains, and silver rings. Top-left: extreme 10cm-low sneaker perspective, with the right sneaker sole filling the foreground as she looks down. Top-right: bird's-eye view of her deep squat and oversized reaching hand. Bottom-left: fisheye-like extreme face close-up with curved alley edges. Bottom-right: seated knee-forward perspective. Keep identity, outfit, environment, and hard 5500K afternoon side-light consistent in every panel. Use 12–14mm ultra-wide perspective, f/8 deep focus, barrel distortion, exaggerated foreshortening, vivid orange subject color, slightly desaturated gritty background, and no readable text, logo, or signature.
